intents.description: User seeks factual information, explanations, definitions, or understanding of a topic. Typically phrased as “what,” “how,” “why,” or “explain” queries. The goal is to receive knowledge or clarification, not to trigger an action or perform a task.
patterns: how do I train a model
what is the difference between ai and ml
give me a simple explanation of convolutional networks
why does training take so long
can you explain bias and variance
explain word embeddings in plain English
how do large language models work
what is the training data source

patterns: search for recent news on climate change
search the knowledge base for onboarding steps
lookup the user manual for model X
search for images of golden retrievers
lookup quarterly revenue for Acme Corp
search the web for Python asyncio examples
find blog posts on prompt engineering
find legislative documents about privacy law
search internal docs for deployment steps
lookup stock price history for AAPL
search news articles about the product launch
search patents related to battery tech
find social posts mentioning our brand
search for tutorials on unit testing
find examples of UX patterns for onboarding
search for images of the Eiffel Tower
search for translations of this phrase
find news on interest rate changes
search for code that implements k-means
find grant opportunities in renewable energy
search for recipes with chicken and rice
lookup the documentation for React hooks
lookup clinical trial results for drug X
lookup the contact details of our CEO
search public datasets on traffic accidents
find step-by-step guide for SSL certificate setup
lookup the full text of RFC 7231
search for reviews of the new smartphone model
what is 2 to the power of 8
what is the sum of 12 and 8

intents.description: Return the current date or time
patterns: show me the current UTC time
what's the current date and time
show me the time in London
what is the current local time

intents.description: Fetch structured domain knowledge from internal database
patterns: get patient records for John Doe
show me the latest sales report
get the financial summary for Q3
retrieve the user permissions for this account

intents.description: User wants metadata or details about a single file or folder on their computer -- its size, type, or when it was created or last modified -- without reading its actual contents. Distinct from reading a file's content and from listing what's inside a folder.
patterns: what type of file is report.pdf
give me details on the folder ~/Documents/notes
show me file info for invoice.csv
what's the file size of this document
what is the creation date of this file
tell me the size of my video.mp4
when was this folder last modified
what is the file extension of document.docx
give me the metadata of file.pdf
how many pages does this PDF have
what's the file size of my project folder
show me details about this document
what's the type of this file

intents.description: User wants to see what files or subfolders exist inside a specific folder or directory on their computer -- a directory listing. Distinct from reading the contents of one particular file or getting metadata about a single file.
patterns: list the files in my downloads folder
what files do I have in this folder
show me what's inside the data folder
what files are in this directory
show all files in this folder
give me a directory listing for ~/Downloads
show me what's in the folder
can you list the files in my documents
what files are under the project folder
list the items in this path

intents.description: User wants the actual contents of a specific local file opened, displayed, or summarized -- reading text, JSON, CSV, or PDF content from a file already on their computer. Distinct from web or knowledge search, and from just listing files in a folder.
patterns: open that config file and show me what's in it
what does this csv file contain
show me the contents of report.pdf
can you read my notes file
what's written in this json file
open and show me that text file
what does my log file say
show me the data from this dirctory
tell me all the data in the python code in here
open this and give what you see in it
open and read the file report.docx
read the text from my notes
show me the file content of index.html
open this file and show its text
give me the text from that document
ok lets try again hopefully its fixed : read this file Desktop\231234623.jpg

intents.description: User wants to search for specific text or a keyword inside their local files or a folder on their computer -- finding which file or line contains a phrase. Distinct from searching the web or a knowledge base; this is specifically about searching inside files already stored on disk.
patterns: find the word TODO in my notes folder
search for 'error' inside the log files
which file mentions the word invoice
grep for 'api_key' in this project folder
search my documents for the word contract
look for the phrase 'unpaid balance' in my files
find all files containing 'password' in this folder
search for 'TODO' in my code files
find the phrase 'confidential' in my documents
look for lines with 'warning' in the log files
where does it say 'urgent' in my emails
search for 'expired' in my contracts folder
find all files that have the word 'meeting' in them

intents.description: User explicitly wants to know the emotional tone or sentiment -- positive, negative, or neutral -- of a specific piece of text, message, or review they provide. Distinct from a general question or casual conversation; the goal is a sentiment or emotion classification of given text.
patterns: what's the sentiment of this message
is this review positive or negative
analyze the tone of this email
how does this text sound, angry or happy?
check the sentiment of: I hate Mondays
rate the sentiment of this paragraph
does this sound upset to you
is this comment positive or negative
analyze the sentiment of this tweet
what's the tone of this customer feedback
does this sound like a complaint
what is the sentiment score of this text
classify the emotion of this passage
tell me if this text is happy or sad
is this feedback favorable or not
